propositions: normalize_ci_conclusion.sh must be ported to a stdlib-only Python entry point that implements the same contract: f(CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) -> vote in {success, failure, cancelled}.
The existing subprocess contract test (test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py) must be re-pointed from the shell script to the new Python entry point while preserving its full case table.

Direct in-process unit tests must cover all contract rows including pass-through cases (success, failure, cancelled), skipped fallback logic (FAILURE_OBSERVED={true,false}), and fail-closed anomaly rows (empty/unrecognized CONCLUSION).
gerrit-verify.yaml must update its sparse-checkout path to fetch the new .py file (cone-mode: false) and update the run step to invoke the Python entry point instead of the shell script.
The shell script file (scripts/normalize_ci_conclusion.sh) must be deleted in the same change to prevent orphaned test references.
